verdict.rationale: The official docs include task-oriented guides with runnable code: a maintained function-calling guide with OpenAI-format examples (a multi-step tool-use flow), a JSON Output guide, and a first-call guide covering streaming. There is no evidence of a cookbook or worked examples covering complete real-world tasks such as agents, RAG or apps that a developer could adapt. Most of the evidenced material reads as feature-level snippets. Missing for 10: a dedicated official cookbook or examples repository, end-to-end application walkthroughs, multi-feature worked examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the examples are useful to adapt.
